description: Original HD-2D pixel-art single static silver birch tree clump, fixed 35-degree elevated three-quarter camera. Crisp intentional pixel clusters, natural low-saturation midtone colors, soft colored contours, convincing volume. TWO leaning slender trunks diverge from one shared root base, left trunk leans left and taller right trunk leans right. Warm milk-grey silver bark with dark charcoal scars and peeling horizontal markings. Fine irregular branching and delicate drooping twigs. SPARSE SMALL LEAVES, dusty yellow-green with some muted ochre, many clear natural windows of transparency. Airy asymmetrical open crown, not dense, not a round ball, not two identical trees. Exposed pale trunks and transparent spaces dominate silhouette. About 4.5m high. Entire tree including top twigs and tapering root ends fits INSIDE frame, minimum 12 transparent pixels on all four sides. Do not crop any leaves, branches or roots. Genuine transparent RGBA background in ALL spaces between leaves and branches, NO opaque white patches, NO checkerboard. Natural neutral material colors for real-time lighting, no baked night tint, no glow, no directional cast shadows. No scenery, ground, grass, platform, text or fruit.
